mapper.select: SELECT ward_id FROM tb_ward WHERE hosp_div_id = #{hospitalId} AND TRIM(ward_nm) LIKE '3%' ORDER BY ward_id LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_emp ( emp_id, emp_pw, hosp_div_id, ward_id, emp_nm, phone_no, role_cd, auth_st, must_change_password ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{passwordHash}, #{hospitalId}, #{wardId}, #{userName}, #{phoneNumber,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'USER', 'APPROVED', TRUE )
